record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.context_brief: uniform boundedness of small canonical height points
record.original_question: Fix a number field K, B≥1, and d≥2. Do there exist ε>0 and C such that, uniformly over generalized Hénon maps f of degree d over K, the set of points P with [K(P):K]≤B and canonical height ĥ_f(P)<ε h(f)+C has uniformly bounded cardinality?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 5. — Let K be a number field, let B ≥ 1, and let d ≥ 2. Then, there exist an ϵ > 0 and constant C ... such that ... #{P ∈ (K)2 : [K(P) : K] ≤ B and ĥf(P) < ϵh(f) + C} is bounded uniformly, where h(f) is the height of the tuple of coefficients of f.

artifact.status_search_result: The question is a dynamical-Lang-type uniform boundedness conjecture for generalized Hénon maps. Recent literature (e.g., work on the abcd conjecture and dynamical uniform boundedness, and the Looper–Silverman–Hyde program for polynomials) treats analogous statements for polynomial maps as conjectural, conditional on deep conjectures in arithmetic geometry. No unconditional resolution for Hénon maps appears in the literature, so the conjecture appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The Uniform Boundedness and Dynamical Lang Conjectures for polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Conditional proof of the Uniform Boundedness Conjecture for polynomials over number fields, together with a dynamical Lang conjecture on minimal canonical heights, assuming a standard conjecture in arithmetic geometry.
status_evidence.claim: The analogous conjecture for polynomials is only proved conditionally, suggesting the Hénon case remains open.

status_evidence.title: The abcd conjecture, uniform boundedness, and dynamical systems
status_evidence.snippet: The abcd conjecture implies a dynamical analogue of Lang's conjecture on lower bounds for canonical heights.
status_evidence.claim: Lower bounds of Lang type for canonical heights in dynamics are conjectural and tied to deep open conjectures.

status_evidence.title: Canonical heights for Hénon maps
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes basic properties of canonical heights for Hénon maps but does not give uniform Lang-type lower bounds.
status_evidence.claim: Foundations exist, but the uniform small-height boundedness conjecture is not resolved.
